mapper.select: SELECT m.agent_id AS owner_id, m.agent_code AS owner_code, m.agent_name AS owner_name, m.status AS owner_status, m.latest_version_no AS version_no, FALSE AS released, (m.status = 'ENABLED') AS active FROM squad_chat.sq_agent m JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version_subagent d ON d.master_version_id = m.latest_version_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.subagent_id = #{agentId} UNION ALL SELECT m.agent_id AS owner_id, m.agent_code AS owner_code, m.agent_name AS owner_name, m.status AS owner_status, r.release_no AS version_no, TRUE AS released, (m.status = 'ENABLED') AS active FROM squad_chat.sq_agent m JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_release r ON r.release_id = m.current_release_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_release_subagent rs WHERE rs.release_id = r.release_id AND rs.subagent_id = #{agentId} ) ORDER BY released DESC, active DESC, owner_code ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent SET agent_name = #{agentName}, display_alias = #{displayAlias}, latest_version_id = #{latestVersionId}, latest_version_no = #{latestVersionNo}, latest_readiness = #{latestReadiness}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent SET current_release_id = #{currentReleaseId}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND agent_type = 'MASTER' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent SET status = #{status}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = 'DISABLED', revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND revision = #{revision}
UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent SET revision = revision WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ENABLED' AND latest_readiness = 'READY'
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(agent_code) FROM squad_chat.sq_agent WHERE agent_code LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
